## Goal / acceptance criteria
Offline Chromium a11y test for the optional phone-call note on the Assisted card (shown after 'Skip, I'll do these by hand' for a call-only site): visible label tied to the field, keyboard order, >=44px targets, >=20px text, contrast in light/dark, error/flash announced via role=status, and no seeded personal values in visible output. Reuse fixtures from `tests/codex/test_cx_review_card_a11y.py`.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.
